correctness.rationale: The proof establishes necessary linear-forest containment, handles the n-1 path obstruction, proves a complement-Hamiltonian lemma at b=5 explicitly and at b>=6 using Dirac, constructs every prescribed trace for b>=5, checks b=2,3,4 individually, and proves the short-path failures. The labeled-path exponential formula yields all coefficients. Independent exhaustive trace enumeration for n=3..7, 209087 nonempty supports, plus 50 component types for n=8,9 agrees. Finite verification is corroboration, not the proof.

value.rationale: The exact edge-shattering polynomial for all Hamiltonian tours is a natural complete invariant of their incidence class, sharper than a VC dimension. The length-three threshold for two spanning path components is a structural boundary, and the exact formula supports sampling calculations and distinguishes high-cardinality trace geometries; this is not a generic finite enumeration or routine renaming of earlier connected-edge bounds.
